rules.desc: Entry type, protocol, listen, and toggles.

config.title: Config
config.desc: Edit and save the full YAML config.

config.saved_hint: Not applied on this gateway yet:

apply.title: Apply
apply.desc: Make saved config or firewall live on this host, or publish a config version for fleet nodes to pull.
apply.hint_config: Make saved config live on this host
apply.hint_config_hot: Hot-apply config on this host: forwarding stays up; most sessions keep
apply.hint_config_hard: Restart forwarding on this host: all sessions drop
apply.hint_firewall: Reload firewall rules on this host
apply.hint_publish: Publish a config version; nodes pull and apply locally
apply.publish_confirm_body: Publishes the current business config as a new fleet version; nodes pull and apply locally.
apply.reload_confirm_body: Backs up and renders config, then restarts forwarding on this host.
apply.hot_confirm_body: Backs up and hot-applies config on this host without restarting forwarding.
apply.fw_confirm_body: Flushes and reloads firewall rules on this host.
apply.none_hint: No pending summaries or results yet.
ops.title: Ops
ops.desc: Local diagnostics, drain, smoke/canary, firewall check, rate limits, and profiles.
fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.desc: Gateway-node registry: join or retire nodes.
fleet.empty_hint: Use Generate join command (top right) on the target host to connect to control.

fleet.leave_confirm_body: Removes “%s” from the registry and revokes its agent credential.
fleet.leave_confirm_body_generic: Removes the gateway node from the registry and revokes its agent credential.
fleet.manual_nlb: Remaining manual step (optional cloud front door)
fleet.toast_copy_err: Copy failed; select the command manually

ops.drain_confirm_ok: Restores health probes so this host takes new connections again.
ops.drain_hint: Stops new traffic; may wait tens of seconds. Existing connections usually remain.
ops.ratelimit_desc: Edit TCP and host-firewall per-IP rate-limit defaults.
ops.ratelimit_toast_conflict: Config changed elsewhere; reloaded — edit again
ops.profile_confirm_body: Writes host defaults only; does not restart forwarding.
ops.profile_empty_hint: This host has no ops profiles, or they failed to load.
ops.toast_fw_root: Firewall needs elevated helper — unavailable now

changes.desc: Browse change summaries by timestamp; roll back when needed.
